candidate_causes.evidence: The formal translation used the opposite matrix ordering from the source packet.
The output may indicate that the source convention was not read or not obeyed, but this is not uniquely determined by one task.

probe_tests.purpose: Distinguish a stable convention error from a one-off algebra slip.
probe_tests.expected_disambiguation: If the agent follows an explicitly changed convention in the probe, source grounding is likely intact; if it reuses the old convention, source-grounding or instruction-following failed.
